articles.summary: Live Nation has signed an agreement to acquire a majority stake in three of Prague’s leading live entertainment venues, marking the beginning of a new chapter for O2 arena (20,000-capacity), O2 Universum (5,000-capacity) and Forum Karlín (4,000-capacity). The deal will create new opportunities for artists, audiences, event organisers and the wider economy.…
articles.title: New Investment To Support The Future Of Prague’s Leading Live Venues

articles.summary: Fans across Uruguay will soon enjoy, through Ticketmaster, a ticket-buying experience designed to make accessing live events simpler, safer and more transparent. Starting today, ticketmaster.uy is live, allowing fans to create an account and get ready to purchase tickets for upcoming live events, which will be available through Ticketmaster. articles.title: Uruguayan fans will soon enjoy a new way to discover, buy and access live events with the arrival of Ticketmaster
